description: Image Description: The image shows an old, box-style cathode-ray tube (CRT) television set discarded on a patch of grass beside a sidewalk. The TV is positioned at an angle, with its screen facing slightly toward the camera and its back partially visible. It has a dark gray or black casing with a silver trim around the front edge of the screen. The screen appears dark and non-functional, likely turned off or broken. The surrounding grass is green but somewhat overgrown, with scattered dry leaves
